name: settings
about: Run an update check, flip one harmless preference back and forth, then switch the appearance to Dark, walk the chat and pages views in it, and set it back to System (a fresh rig starts on System). Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 settings/src/lib.rs:825-955 — panes and choices are Buttons that report checked (epoch 8 has no Tab or RadioButton on the wire): readable, but a screen reader hears buttons

steps.say: open the Settings tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Settings tab is selected and the settings view shows General, Network, Account and Security buttons with General checked, and an Updates label with a Check now button; status notes such as 'Last check refused: sequence_not_newer.' are states, not errors; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

the check ran: the Last check row reads just now or Checking…, or the update note reads a result such as 'Up to date.' or 'Last check refused: sequence_not_newer.', or a Ready to install row shows; a refusal note is a state, not an error

steps.say: press Off under Mentions and direct messages
steps.expect: Off reports checked and the detail reads 'Silent — the bell is the only notice.'

steps.say: press On under Mentions and direct messages
steps.expect: On reports checked and the detail reads 'A desktop banner when you are named, or written to directly.'
Network reports checked; Reconnect and Switch network buttons and a node RPC URL field show
General reports checked and the Updates label shows
Dark reports checked (System and Light do not) and the Appearance detail reads 'Pinned for this device.'

steps.say: open the Chat tab in the rail
steps.expect: in the dark appearance the Chat tab is selected and the chat view still shows its controls by name: a New channel button and a Channels label, and every button in it has a name; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: open the Pages tab in the rail
steps.expect: in the dark appearance the Pages tab is selected and the pages view still shows its controls by name: a New page button, and every button in it has a name; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: open the Settings tab in the rail
steps.expect: the settings view shows the General pane with Dark checked under Appearance
System reports checked and the Appearance detail reads 'Following the system appearance.'
